summary: The XSS flaw is that attacker-controlled data read from the socket in 61b.badSource() is concatenated directly into an HTML `img src` attribute in 61a.bad() and written to the response without encoding. The fix HTML-encodes the data before it is placed into the attribute context, neutralizing characters that could break out of the attribute or inject markup, while preserving normal values which render unchanged.
